Dr Neil J. Davies D.C, is a reputed chiropractic author and educator. As the author of Clinical Paediatrics A Clinical Handbook, Churchill Livingstone (2000 & 2010), he became well known for post-graduate chiropractic education in teaching the prudent examination and care of children. From 2000, he traveled widely and presented seminars in many countries helping chiropractors better understand excellence in clinical care for children of all ages.

Dr Davies developed a system or technique of subluxation assessment and treatment initially taught as Adjusting the Child and later evolving to the NeuroImpulse Protocol, also known as NIP. This is still taught widely in many countries and has a popular folowing.

Dr Davies developed a range of clinical educational teaching products and his latest online learning resource is called NIP Academy which is free for chiropractors to join at the Bronze level and allows upgrades inside for more materials. It includes seminars in streaming video.
